question_evidence_quote: Uncle Lou was given four bags of peanuts to eat on his 2-hour plane flight.  Each bag contains 30 peanuts.
observed_error: The response uses the four bags as the total number of peanuts.
violated_condition: Total peanuts must equal 4 bags × 30 peanuts per bag.
error_description: The response sets the number of peanuts to 4, although four is the number of bags and each bag contains 30 peanuts. It therefore divides the 120-minute flight by the bag count instead of the peanut count. The resulting 30 follows that incorrect divisor; it is not an arithmetic execution error.
